name: (04) Daimoinon — 3 Advanced — Glimpse the Gulf Beyond

system.description:
There are worlds beyond worlds and places beyond space and time; this power allows a Baali to shatter the boundaries between such zones of cosmic terror and the mundane world. Glimpse the Gulf Beyond is never used lightly, for even the masters of Daimoinon fear what they might see, or what might see them. Baali are immune to this power, but even among their own ranks few gaze willingly into the Void, or do so for long.

System: The player spends a Willpower point, then rolls Stamina + Occult (difficulty 7) against the target's Willpower roll (difficulty also 7). The attacker's leftover successes dictate the effect: 1 success shakes the onlooker, costing a temporary Willpower point and a one-die penalty on all rolls for the scene; 2 successes cost two temporary Willpower and force a Courage roll (difficulty 10 minus current Willpower) against Rötschreck, plus the one-die penalty; 3 successes cost three temporary Willpower and force a Self-Control/Instinct roll (difficulty 7) or the target loses consciousness, and even on a success he suffers a two-die penalty for the scene; 4 successes cost four temporary Willpower and force a Self-Control/Instinct roll (difficulty 8) or the target falls catatonic for an hour; 5+ successes force a Willpower roll (difficulty 7) or the target is reduced to permanent gibbering idiocy (and even on a success, treat the effect as 4 successes). Reducing a victim's Willpower to zero this way may leave her with a random Derangement, temporary or permanent. A botch means something has gone terribly wrong with the attempt to open the portal — backlash from the Other Side, an unwanted visitor escaping into this realm, or even the Baali's own abduction, at the Storyteller's discretion.
system.source: Clanbook: Baali, Chapter Three: Descent into Darkness
